en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abu Abdullah Al Razy, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Abdullah Al Momin, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Is the adulterer more evil or drinker of the wine? And how did eighty lashes come to be with regards to the wine, and a hundred regarding adultery?’ So heasws said: ‘O Is’haq! The Penalty (Hadd) is one, but there is an increase in this due to his wasting of the sperm and placing it in other than its (rightful) place which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Commanded it with’.
